subject.title: [Bug] Race condition in approval-classifier.ts when tokenization exceeds max tokens

question: Does the reporter have sufficient private current-main evidence to establish an approval-boundary bypass before this issue is treated as an implementation task?
rationale: The allegation is security-sensitive, but neither the public report nor the inspected current-main path identifies the tokenizer, token ceiling, concurrent callback ordering, or payload required to verify it safely.

options.title: Request private reproduction
options.body: Ask for the exact current-main payload sequence, ACP client and SDK versions, token-limit source, timestamped protocol trace, and observed unapproved action before authorizing code changes.

options.title: Close if unsupported
options.body: If no concrete private reproduction can be supplied after a bounded review window, close the report and invite a new private security report with an executable trace.

recommendation.title: Request private reproduction
recommendation.body: Ask for the exact current-main payload sequence, ACP client and SDK versions, token-limit source, timestamped protocol trace, and observed unapproved action before authorizing code changes.

likelyOwner.reason: They are publicly credited with the ACP semantic approval-classification work and subscribed to this report.
